world.name: Emerald Keep
world.description: A large six-zone IFW campaign. Emerald Keep begins as a lantern-lit hub, then expands into the Thornwild, Emberdeep, Vel'rasha, the Moonfall Archive, and the Starless Citadel. The main story follows four relics guarded by escalating bosses, each relic awakening part of the final gate. The world also demonstrates faction branches, companions, vendors, exchange rates, crafting, locked rooms, hidden exits, mazes, mining, utility interactions, stealth, poison, charged items, class-specific spells, and ending choices.

class.name: Warrior
class.description: A disciplined defender who turns focus and steel into forward momentum.

class.name: Mage
class.description: A keeper of moonlit formulas, fragile at first but dangerous once advanced spells open.

class.name: Rogue
class.description: A nimble problem-solver who survives by striking first and leaving before trouble settles.

faction.name: Town Watch
faction.description: Road wardens, well keepers, and practical neighbors who protect the keep from immediate danger.

faction.name: Moon Archive
faction.description: Scholars who preserve the keep's oldest rites, even when those rites argue back.
